name: Jakarta
summary: Jakarta is a vibrant and affordable megacity, with a remarkably low cost of living for Southeast Asia, ideal for nomads on a tight budget. Traffic is legendarily chaotic and air pollution can be a serious problem for much of the year, but the local tech scene is booming, with startups like Gojek and Tokopedia driving an increasingly mature digital ecosystem. Fixed internet is reasonable in central areas, although it varies greatly depending on the neighborhood.
strengths: Low cost of living IDR 432/month — 50% below the average of the 90 cities
